issues.body_excerpt:

exponential backoff.

issues.title: Dashboard takes 8 seconds to load
issues.body_excerpt: The home dashboard issues 40 separate API calls on load. Batch them.

issues.title: Search endpoint times out on large workspaces
issues.body_excerpt:
`/v1/search` takes more than 30s and times out for workspaces with over
100k documents.

issues.title: Bulk import is slow for large CSV files
issues.body_excerpt:
Importing a 50k-row CSV takes over 20 minutes. Profiling shows most of the
time is spent waiting because requests get throttled by the rate limit.

issues.title: Make the per-tenant rate limit configurable
issues.body_excerpt:
Large tenants hit the default limit during bulk imports. Allow admins to
raise the rate limit per tenant from the settings page.

issues.title: API returns 429 when rate limit is exceeded
issues.body_excerpt:
Calling `/v1/items` more than ~60 times per minute returns HTTP 429 with no
`Retry-After` header, so clients cannot back off correctly.

Expected: a `Retry-After` header on every 429 response.
